scope: Read-only production release readiness audit and maintenance proposal

observations.filesystemOwnership: Inspected application and data directory ownership and private file modes; this does not prove current business-record ownership.

sqliteAccess.businessOwnershipAndCurrentGrantFingerpr: not established by this read-only metadata audit

existingCompatibility.status: previously passed but expired and bound to a different candidate

observations.backupContract: Existing controller backs up stopped application data and Caddyfile; runtime.env is not listed as a backup artifact. Absence of an env copy is not itself a contract violation. Preserve its original bytes and hash.
observations.legacyAuditLimitation: One historical release root (5c3786dd3ac6) returned a bounded RuntimeError guard. It was not treated as a usable or fully audited release artifact.

blockingGates: No desired 66-file candidate in an eligible new production staging root.
No fresh, real-data compatibility proof bound to current configuration, authority, dependencies and desired candidate.
Current independent multilingual gate deliberately disables its production CLI; a reviewed hash-bound production entry is not prepared.
Existing backup metadata is not a fresh verified consistent backup of current live data.
Current business ownership and grant fingerprint must be established safely from consistent data, not inferred from a WAL-bearing main database alone.

proposedNextStages.name: Local-only production entry preparation
actions: Implement an explicit hash-bound entry around the reviewed multilingual gate without bypassing its disabled CLI.
Keep exact 20-path change scope and full previous/candidate inventories; preserve all configuration, client allowlist and authority checks.
Add local synthetic entry, timeout, interruption, rollback and configuration-preservation regressions.

proposedNextStages.name: Separately approved production staging and fresh data evidence
actions: Use a new exclusive release tag, never reuse a completed or failed release root.
Stage the accepted 66-file payload with canonical ownership, dependency and controller hashes.
Preserve live raw config, runtime.env and the existing one-client allowlist; never install synthetic rehearsal configuration.
Use a reviewed consistent snapshot method for current databases and their WAL state. If a service pause is required, obtain a separate bounded window first.
Obtain fresh old/candidate database-copy compatibility and authorization/schema bindings within the 3600-second proof lifetime.
Request any required additional isolated test unit explicitly; do not reuse consumed allocations.

proposedNextStages.name: Fresh maintenance approval only after every gate passes
actions: Refresh and verify the consistent backup before switching code.
Validate candidate, live source, configuration, authority, dependencies, proof freshness, ownership and headroom immediately before release.
Update only the approved public application and HTTPS assets; no legacy LACK or Relay operations.
Rollback on failure without overwriting newer user data or configuration; do not delete abandoned writer locks.

proposedNextStages.name: Production acceptance, separately scoped
actions: Verify human Pocket ID callback, language switching, help assets and TLS access-control rejection boundaries.
Do not infer external Agent authorization or real-model acceptance from local or isolated test success.
Propose any real research workload budget separately; do not trigger Muse or dots during interface acceptance.

remainingDeliveryBoundary: This audit and isolated rehearsal do not mean the bilingual candidate is in production, Muse Suhua is connected, or all real research/external-Agent acceptance is complete.
